headline: Kyrgyz Republic GDP expands 10.5% in first ten months of 2026
summary: Gross domestic product in the Kyrgyz Republic reached 1.87 trillion soms ($21.4 billion) between January and October, advancing 10.5% year-on-year across industry and services, according to state statistics.
why: Central Asian economies are experiencing rapid growth driven by regional transit, manufacturing, and shifting trade routes across Eurasia.

entities.name: National Statistical Committee of the Kyrgyz Republic

impacts.name: Kyrgyz Republic
impacts.why: Preliminary official data confirms double-digit real gross domestic product growth.
